question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

One who gives shape to stone
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(2) i.e. **'Sculptor'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word group words-One who gives shape to stone or carving out on stone is called** 'Sculptor'.**(नक्कासिकार)

 
 
• Example:- Gitam hired a** sculptor** to make the temple looking good.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is option no.(2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Other options are-**
 
• **Curator- **A person whose job is to look after the things that are kept in a museum.**(संग्रहालय रक्षक)**
 
 
• **Example:- **The** curator** gave an advice to be careful for the wild animals.
 
 
 
• **Apostate- **A person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle.**(धर्म भंजक)**
 
 
• **Example:- **He is an **apostate **person never believes in religious principles.
 
 
 
• **Auditor-** A person who examines company's financial records.**(लेखाकार)**
 
 
• **Example:-** I was selected for the post of an **auditor** last year.

The correct answer is 'Option 2&
